title: The odd fermion at the edge: odd-even staggering in the trapped, unitary Fermi gas
summary: We investigate the odd-even staggering in the harmonically-trapped unitary Fermi gas at large particle-number charge $Q$. Using both a large-$N$ BdG description and a complementary large-charge EFT method, we show that for odd particle number the extra fermion forms an edge-localized quasiparticle near the Thomas-Fermi surface rather than a bulk excitation.
